name: Kling AI
description: Kling is Kuaishou's flagship video-generation model, competing at the top end with Sora and Veo. Kling 3.0 (February 2026) supports multi-shot scenes, character consistency, and fine motion control. Reported ~$240M ARR run rate makes it one of the largest standalone video-AI products globally.
pricingDetails: Free: 66 credits/day. Standard: $10/month. Pro: $25.99/month. Premier: $64.99/month. Ultra: $180/month.
